errors.quote: There are $qK$ rounds on chunk bits and $b+1$ on prefix bits, $\ell$ in all.
errors.problem: This holds only when at least one axis is long. If every t_i = 2^{ell-1}, the round at h=ell-1 does not occur, leaving b prefix rounds and ell-1 rounds in total. The paper says 'at most b+1 <= K rounds on prefix slots' and 'at most ell rounds'. The page repeats the point with 'the $\ell$ rounds leave error'. The bound is unaffected.

errors.quote: The transform has $\ell$ rounds, and each round applies the two-point averaging and differencing step to one address bit of every axis.
errors.problem: In the first round (named position h=ell-1) only the long axes take part, and there may be ell-1 rounds. The paper: 'First process the round at named position h=ell-1 on the long axes, if there are any.'

errors.quote: The record permutation $L$, built below, moves them together once. Every later round is then a single layer.
errors.problem: Only the qK chunk rounds are single simultaneous layers. The up to b+1 rounds on prefix slots process their participating bits one at a time at O(Tp) each, as the page itself says later and as the paper does ('In a round on prefix slots, process the participating bits individually').
